runStatus: Incomplete evidence for first two synthetic documents; every document attempted once per intended context.
runNotes: One attempted pass over ten documents plus automatic and bound two-deck scenarios. No document was retried in the same context. Two harness failures interrupted reporting; continuation skipped already attempted documents using a temporary copy of the same entry with only the document filter changed.

First attempt called ingestion/extraction for synthetic-de-analysis, then failed at nonexistent sources.get before recording metrics. Its throwaway database was removed. Outcome and exact cost are unavailable.

Next attempt recorded synthetic-en-econometrics: extraction done, Obligation and deadline precision/recall 1, reviewableAfterMs 17673. It then failed on a bigint allowance sum before the next document made model calls. Full evidence and exact cost were lost with the throwaway database.

Remaining eight documents and both scenarios completed with recorded evidence. Both harness errors were fixed. The eval entry was explicitly typechecked because worker tsconfig excludes evals. Feature implementation was not changed.
OPENROUTER_BASE_URL was missing; used ADR-0012 international endpoint https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Secrets were loaded only into the eval environment.

Measured cost covers twelve fully recorded attempts. Each interrupted attempt had a hard USD 0.50 Allowance; reserving their full USD 1.00 bounds total cost. The continuation enforced a USD 3.90 aggregate cap.

Figure-only counts are stored Fact extraction rows whose decrypted uncertainty contains aus einer Abbildungsbeschreibung abgeleitet; Topics are the topic subset. Counts are per Source, not deduplicated across uploads.

Topic scores use exact one-to-one aliases. Shared-course review can select an earlier Source value; raw-key recovery by selected value and current Provenance can then fail. Unresolved keys fall back to selected values, so scenario Topic metrics are conservative and not reliable estimates. Standalone slide decks have no unresolved cited keys.
Labels remain draft, not yet spot-checked by founder. No Topic merge threshold has been set.
